newsitem.title: USA: Peerless Manufacturing adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Peerless Manufacturing adopts rights plan.

text.p: Peerless Mfg Co said Wednesday its board had adopted a shareholder rights plan in which rights to buy shares of the company's common stock will be distributed as a dividend to shareholders of record June 2.
The rights are not exercisable until a person or group acquires more than 20 percent of the company's common stock or announces a tender or exchange offer for such an amount.
At that time, rights holders will be entitled to receive a number of common shares having a market value equal to twice the rights exercise price, the company said.
The company said the rights plan was not adopted in response to any known offers for Peerless Manufacturing.
"We believe that the current market and economic environment make the adoption of the plan a prudent step to take at this time," the company said in a statement Wednesday evening.
Peerless makes separators and filters for the petroleum, natural gas, petrochemical and electric utility industries and environmental protection equipment.
